about: Constants and functions whose literals the line register does not count, because nothing that puts words on a player's screen reads them. Each is proved by its readers in tests/guards/english/line-register.test.ts (exemptProblems): every use of the name in a source file that is not a test or developer file reads only a field named in reads. A new entry needs a reason; a new reader fails the guard.

symbols.name: REPLY_FOLLOWS_RUBRIC
symbols.reason: The reader's rubric for whether a reply follows its line; read only by the words scripts and tests that grade pairs.

symbols.name: REGISTER_CARDS
symbols.reason: Each speech register's measured checks and their sources; play reads only a card's setting and devices, which are record values, never its check labels.

symbols.name: RECORD_2025
symbols.reason: Source citation for the register checks, read only inside REGISTER_CARDS.

symbols.name: seatingProblems
symbols.reason: Seating check's problem list; read only by the developer check m2-10-check.ts and its test.

symbols.name: reachReport
symbols.reason: A scene-reach report for developers; read only by its test and the scene-year script.

symbols.name: placeRuleProblems
symbols.reason: A line rule's problems in the bank files; read only by its test and the line-rules guard.

symbols.name: COMPOSED_CHECKS
symbols.reason: The composed-text checks by rule id; run only by the words scripts and tests over composed samples, so a break's why is never said.

symbols.name: organizationNamedOnce
symbols.reason: One composed-text check, read only through COMPOSED_CHECKS.

symbols.name: runComposedRules
symbols.reason: Runs the composed checks over a sample; read only by the words script composed.ts and the composed-rules guard.
